sequence:
@startuml
actor "tom : Member" as M
participant "terminal : Terminal" as T
participant Copy
M -> T : borrow(1043)
activate T
alt available
  T -> Copy : ok = isAvailable()
  Copy --> T : yes
else
  T --> M : "not available"
end
T ->> Copy : log()
[-> T : wake()
T ->] : notify()
deactivate T
@enduml
